title: Fix ByteRanges merging (multi-range spans, touching neighbours) and half-open membership

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 1: add raises ValueError if start < 0 or end < start.
Rule 1: add(x, x) is a no-op.
Current behavior (bug report): ranges() [(0,45)], covered() 45, missing(50) [(45,50)].
Rule 2: a new range may overlap, bridge or contain any number of existing ranges; rule 3 covered().
Rule 2: minimal, sorted, non-overlapping description after a range spanning several ranges.
Rule 2: [0,10) and [10,20) are merged whichever was added first (following range added first).
Rule 2: touching ranges are merged (previous range added first).
Rule 2: a new range may bridge existing ranges; touching ranges merge.
Rule 2: no two ranges touch after any sequence of adds, in any order.
Rule 2: touching ranges merge regardless of order.
Rule 2: a range contained in existing ranges changes nothing; rule 3 covered().
Rule 2: overlapping ranges with the same start merge.
Rule 2: only overlapping or touching ranges merge (a 1-byte gap keeps them apart).
Rule 2: list of (start, end) tuples sorted by start.
Rules 2-4 checked against a set-of-bytes model (fixed seed).
Rule 4: offset in received iff start <= offset < end for some range.
Rule 4: nothing is contained in an empty ByteRanges.
Rule 5: sorted maximal gaps of [0, size).
Rule 5: with nothing received the gap is [0, size).
Rule 5: received bytes at or beyond size are ignored.
Rules 2 and 5: missing/is_complete after out-of-order touching adds.
Rule 5: is_complete(size) iff missing(size) is empty; bytes beyond size ignored.
